subject: Redwood thank-you: credits, fulfillment schedule, and receipt request
messages:
From: Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@optilabs.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
Cc: OpTiLabs Procurement <procurement@optilabs.com>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood thank-you — next steps for credits / gift options

Hi Ava,

Thank you again for the case study spotlight — the team at OpTiLabs really appreciated the support. Procurement asked me to confirm the logistics for the thank-you package and the company donation. Two quick asks:  

1) Billing/credits: can you confirm the $3,000 credit is going to our master account (account #OPTI-001)? We need a short invoice/credit memo for our finance team.
2) Swag: we prefer a mix of T-shirts (mixed sizes) and laptop stickers. I can send a shipping address file but wanted to confirm we can get a packing manifest.
3) Donation: we requested the $1,000 donation to go to "TechAccess Foundation" and need an official donation receipt for our records.

Can you confirm timeline and next steps? We hope to close this out before the end of next week.

Best,
Emily Rogers
Director, Marketing Partnerships
OpTiLabs

[Attachment: optilabs_shipping_addresses.csv (CSV, 8 KB)]

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@optilabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 28 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood thank-you — next steps for credits / gift options

Hi Emily — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Marissa (ops) and Rishi (finance) to handle fulfillment and the invoice/donation receipt. Quick answers below and a proposed timeline.

- Credits: we will issue a $3,000 account credit to OPIT-001. Rishi, can you prepare a credit memo and PDF invoice for Emily's finance team?
- Swag: Marissa will produce a packing manifest and shipping ETA. Confirmed items: 50 tees (mixed sizes), 200 stickers, and 5 hats. We can accept the CSV you attached.
- Donation: Redwood will process the $1,000 donation to TechAccess Foundation and provide a PDF receipt.

Proposed timeline:
- Today (Aug 28): finance prepares credit memo / invoice and ops starts swag manifest.
- Aug 31: donation processed; receipt generated.
- Sept 2: swag ships; tracking info to Emily.

Marissa/Rishi — can you confirm you have what you need and call out any blockers? Emily — if any shipping addresses are restricted (e.g., campus addresses), flag them in your CSV.

Thanks!

— Ava Chen
Partnerships Lead, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Emily Rogers <emily.rogers@optilabs.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 31 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood thank-you — next steps for credits / gift options

Thanks, Ava. I imported Emily's CSV and validated addresses for the first 30 recipients. A few notes and requests:  

- One address row had a PO Box; we cannot ship tees to PO Boxes. Emily, please provide a street address for that contact (row 14).
- Sizing: the CSV has approximate sizes, but we'll include a small-size/medium-size mix unless you specify.
- Manifest: attached is the initial swag_manifest_optilabs.csv with quantities and SKUs.

Shipping plan:
- We will create two parcels (domestic ground); estimated ship date Sept 2, delivery by Sept 4 (dependent on carrier).
- I will provide tracking numbers and an itemized packing manifest once shipments are collected.

[Attachment: swag_manifest_optilabs.csv (CSV, 6 KB)]

Marissa Cole

marissa.cole@redwood.ai
